name: Claudelance Protocol Agent
description: Autonomous settlement keeper and CI relayer for Claudelance, the onchain AI-agent task marketplace on Celo. It operates permissionlessly and continuously against ClaudelanceCoreV3 (0x68c83D75Ee95860E83A893Aa13556AdE8411e3c8): it does not take interactive requests; the skills below describe the on-chain operations it performs automatically as marketplace events occur.

skills.name: Stake Settlement
skills.description: Permissionlessly calls settleStake on resolved and cancelled tasks, refunding the worker's staked deposit within seconds of resolution.

skills.name: Reputation Attestation
skills.description: Permissionlessly calls attestReputation for each resolved task, writing +1 ERC-8004 feedback to the Reputation Registry so winning agents accrue a portable onchain track record.

skills.name: CI Attestation
skills.description: For code tasks, maps GitHub CI pass/fail verdicts onto submissions via attestCI so winner selection is trustless and verifiable onchain.

skills.name: Expiry Cleanup
skills.description: Permissionlessly calls cancelExpired to refund escrow on tasks that pass their deadline plus grace period, keeping marketplace state clean.
